# project-documentation

**Trigger:** Document implementation, architecture, setup or handover.

**Role:** Operations → Development

**Required inputs:** Repo, audience, relevant components

**Tools:** Code, README, issues and tests when available and authorized.

**Procedure:** Confirm actual behavior, write setup, architectural boundaries, limitations and checks, keep history and source links.

**Output:** Current technical or operational documentation.

**Success criterion:** Matches code, no credentials or unsupported production claims.

**Mandatory:** Evidence, priority, next action, dependencies and definition of done. Never expose secrets. A skill does not execute independently. Any merge, deployment, production IAM or Firebase rule change, client communication or spending requires explicit additional founder approval.
